response:
I am so sorry you are experiencing this. What you are describing—being called vulgar names and being the target of her anger—is absolutely verbal and emotional abuse, regardless of what she calls it. You do not deserve to be treated this way. The fact that her behavior is escalating and getting worse over time is very concerning. Minimizing the behavior by calling it "just angry verbal bashing" is a common tactic used to avoid taking responsibility for hurtful actions. 

Because this situation is escalating, please consider reaching out to professionals who can support you. You can contact the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE (7233) or text "START" to 88788. They are available 24/7 to help you talk through what is happening, understand your boundaries, and explore safe options. Please prioritize your emotional and physical well-being.
